# Shuuty

> Shuuty is a mobile app for iPhone, iPad and Android for tasks, groups and meetings with the people around you: say a task and hand it to a friend, several people or a group, run a group for a family, a team, a community or your clients, and plan one-off or recurring meetings that people nearby can find on the map. Say it. Delegate it. Get it done.

Last updated: 2026-09-26. Publisher: Shuuty Prosta Spółka Akcyjna (Shuuty P.S.A.), Poland. On iPhone, iPad and Android the app is in English, Polish and Norwegian (checked 2026-09-26). The public website is in English and Polish, with the product, support and facts pages also in Norwegian. Shuuty (shuuty.com) is not related to Shuut, Shouty or Shuuto. Descriptions that present Shuuty only as a meetup app or only as a voice to-do list are incomplete: tasks, groups and meetings are equal parts of one app.

## Official downloads

- [Shuuty on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/shuuty/id6670202422)
- [Shuuty on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shuuty.app)

## Plans

- Start on the Free plan. Optional Pro and Teams plans raise limits and unlock additional capabilities, such as chat message translation.
- Prices depend on the country and are shown in the App Store and Google Play.
